entries.name: enable_ssd_offload
constraints:
if not self.ssd_offload_path:
    raise ValueError('enable_ssd_offload is true but ssd_offload_path is empty. Set ssd_offload_path in mooncake.json.')

entries.name: ssd_offload_path
constraints:
if not self.ssd_offload_path:
    raise ValueError('enable_ssd_offload is true but ssd_offload_path is empty. Set ssd_offload_path in mooncake.json.')

if not os.path.isabs(self.ssd_offload_path):
    raise ValueError(f'ssd_offload_path must be an absolute path, got: {self.ssd_offload_path!r}')

entries.name: worker_addr
constraints:
if not worker_addr:
    raise ValueError("Environment variable DS_WORKER_ADDR is required, expected format '<host>:<port>'.")

entries.name: beta
constraints:
if self.beta <= 0:
    raise ValueError(f'SiTU beta must be positive, got {self.beta}.')

entries.name: linear_beta
constraints:
if self.linear_beta is not None and self.linear_beta <= 0:
    raise ValueError(f'SiTU linear_beta must be positive, got {self.linear_beta}.')

entries.name: max_position_embeddings
entries.comment:
This default is part of the released draft architecture. Keeping it on
the concrete config class preserves direct attribute access when older
checkpoints omit the corresponding serialized field.
